workflows.description: Build a scoped product feature or enhancement.

steps.action: State assumptions, target files, and success criteria.
Read the focused context pack and use rg to locate existing patterns.
Make the smallest scoped code or doc changes that satisfy the request.
Run the relevant checks.
Write the per-question log under .agents/logs.
Report changed files, verification result, and remaining risk.

workflows.description: Fix a reported defect with minimal change.

steps.action: Reproduce or explain why reproduction is not possible in the current environment.
Locate the smallest failing path and related contracts.
Patch only the failing behavior.
Run focused checks first, then broader checks if risk warrants it.
Log the work and summarize the fix.

workflows.description: Review code, docs, or architecture for risks and missing verification.

steps.action: Read the changed files and relevant source-of-truth docs.
List bugs, regressions, missing tests, and contract risks first.
List blocking questions or assumptions.
Summarize only after findings.

workflows.description: Check repository, frontend, or deploy readiness.

steps.action: Read AGENTS.md, agent-config, MCP skill, and deploy/readiness docs.
Run non-destructive readiness checks.
Report pass/fail, blockers, and next safe action.

workflows.description: Align instructions, module docs, context docs, and skills after scope changes.

steps.action: Find all references to the concept being renamed or split.
Patch only the docs needed to remove ambiguity.
Use rg to verify new labels and old ambiguous references.
Write the per-question log.
